north_stars.name: State that tells the truth
north_stars.statement: Every status, number and gate verdict is derived from evidence a reader can re-check, and nothing computable is stored as an assertion.

north_stars.name: Unattended execution
north_stars.statement: An orchestrator carries a sprint from ready node to committed evidence without a human in the loop, and holds recoverably rather than failing when it must stop.

north_stars.name: Legible to human and agent alike
north_stars.statement: A person and an agent read the same plan state through surfaces suited to each, with neither a second store nor a second truth.

north_stars.name: Portable across harnesses
north_stars.statement: Reckon's contracts hold whichever agent harness runs the work, so adding a backend never adds a second execution path.
